name: selfhost-compose-smoke
cost_provenance: measured 2026-09-30 on the dev workstation: 2.7-20 s typical, up to 90 s when the Docker CLI itself was slow (`docker compose version` alone took 14-31 s). The cost is Docker start-up, not the file. Finalize budget = 5x = 150 s; the oracle's own docker timeout is 120 s and answers `unknown` (exit 3) past it.
question: Does the self-host compose file validate, and is every setting it or the api reads documented in SELFHOST_ENV.md (C21)? A: docker compose config (pyyaml fallback; neither available = unknown). B: compose env refs are in the catalog. D: every FEEDBACKMONK_*/DATABASE_URL/RUST_LOG literal in the crates the api links is in the catalog. C (--full): clean-state up + /health/ready.

output.schema: PASS or FAIL <n> with probe-level offender detail (file:line). Exit 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 environment error, 3 unknown (no validator / Docker timeout). A missing target is a FAIL, never a vacuous PASS.

consultation.typical_sessions_using: every-commit-during-P4+ (touching deploy/docker or SELFHOST_ENV.md); /0-uldf-finalize Phase 11 with --full

consumer_scope: P4+ deploy/docker/** + docs/operations/SELFHOST_ENV.md (every commit touching either; CI gate post-launch with --full)
